synergies.notes: Amplify increases melee retaliation damage.
Amplify increases reflected magic damage.
Amplify increases ranged retaliation damage.
Concentrated incoming damage can activate Enrage.
Extra melee attacks may create additional kill and trample opportunities.
Random targets reduce the reliability of exploiting Taunt for doubled damage.
Physical mitigation makes restored health last longer.
Magic mitigation increases the effective value of self-healing.
Immunity prevents Affliction from disabling healing.
Last Stand increases maximum health and the resulting heal amount.
Self-healing supports a unit absorbing focused attacks.
Restored armor can absorb magic damage.
Additional armor improves repair availability.
Resurrection restores Divine Shield for another blocked hit.
Rebirth restores a protective shield.
Independent evasion bonuses improve physical attack avoidance.
Phase extends evasion to magic attacks.
Flying evasion can also protect against magic.
Blind can reduce magic accuracy against a unit with Phase.
Additional misses create more Backfire opportunities.
Flying increases opportunities for missed attacks.
Stun activates the doubled-damage condition of Knock Out.
Additional hits create more chances to gain maximum health.
Additional attacks increase chances to secure kills and grow.
More attacks improve the chance to apply Poison.
Extra attacks and overflow damage reduce armor waste.
Overflow and adjacent damage increase effective damage output.
Random back-line targets can deal Blast damage to two neighbors.
Targeting low-health units improves kill conversion.
Back-line targeting can create accessible kills.
Kill-triggered growth strengthens subsequent attacks.
Healing prevention makes persistent damage harder to recover from.
Combined physical and magic mitigation covers both damage families.
Focused targeting alongside retaliation protection improves survival.
Accumulated health supports a surviving last unit.
Rebirth can allow the death-triggered buff to occur again.
True Strike makes increased attack power reliable.
An additional life can create another Martyr trigger.

statSynergies.notes: Weakening opposing melee can improve direct melee exchanges.
A magic attacker also reduces opposing magic pressure.
A ranged attacker also reduces opposing ranged pressure.
Higher maximum health increases the amount self-healed.
An armored unit can benefit directly from repair.
A second attack scales with attack power.
A second ranged attack scales with ranged power.
A second magic attack scales with magic power.
Large attacks improve adjacent damage after rounding.
High speed improves the magic evasion enabled by Phase.
Remaining armor supplies attack power to Armored Strike.
Strong magic power can be shared with eligible adjacent units.
